summary: Planning-only split of I01d into two pending B1 children: real generated SQLDelight storage/repository/forward-migration foundation qualified with file-backed host SQLite; Android production driver, non-destructive lifecycle/backup handling, normal-APK wiring and focused instrumentation assembly. I01d stays in-progress with its original outcome/checks for later combined qualification. Device-driver execution remains I01f after adapter qualification; no dependency cycle or per-child independent review. No runtime/build/UI/runner inputs changed and no application behavior, device check or release gate is claimed passed.
selectionReason: The actual clean master checkout matches the supplied startCommit, is active/authorized under D-304 and has no findings or due capability reviews. I01a/I01b/I01c and the server descendants are implemented; I01d depends on I01a and is the earliest eligible implementation task. Its actual module is still an empty Android adapter with no SQLDelight/plugin/schema/driver/repository or storage tests. The selected outcome spans independently testable generated storage/migration and Android driver/lifecycle/backup boundaries. A pre-coding split bounds dependency/tool qualification and failure-preserving SQLite checks separately from Android callbacks and normal-app integration, retaining the whole original parent obligation rather than skipping to I01e or claiming a partial storage implementation complete.

children.I01d1: Minimal generated SQLDelight schema/query/repository and failure-preserving open/migration boundary; real file-backed host SQLite fresh/atomicity/rollback/reopen/retained-upgrade/failure tests; qualified locked dependency/license provenance.
children.I01d2: Production Android SQLDelight driver and non-destructive callbacks, off-main normal-app wiring/failure handling, private backup/device-transfer exclusions and focused actual-driver instrumentation APK assembly, with execution explicitly deferred to I01f.

planning.dependencies: I01d1 depends on implemented I01a; I01d2 depends on I01d1. Neither depends on the open parent or on I01f. I01d retains its original I01a dependency and full outcome/checks; a later fresh parent unit qualifies the combined host/storage/Android assembly interfaces after both children. I01f still depends on completed I01d and supplies actual Android-driver instrumentation execution after adapter qualification. I01e and I02-I36 remain unchanged. The outer I01 parent still checks all six original foundation children before I02.
planning.reviewBoundary: Both children inherit B1. Independent B1 review remains after I01-I04 and descendants, never after these children. No existing review scopes/coverage/commit, findings, authorization, runner, model, permissions or external gates change.
coverage: Fresh SQLDelight create/generated queries, real SQLite repository transactions, atomic accepted records/cursor, rollback/reopen and retained populated older-schema forward migration are implemented and host-tested in I01d1; its exact production repository/open contract is reused by I01d2.

I01d1 tests migration failure after prior statements, future/invalid schema refusal, old DB/version/data preservation and no writable repository on failure. I01d2 qualifies the actual Android callback/error-handler and initialization wiring, adds equivalent device-driver assertions and compiles them. The pending I01f executes those assertions, so host-driver success is never represented as Android execution.

Accepted replica, refetchable/derived cache and personal saved-state categories stay distinct. No persisted outgoing requests, predictions, unreported exposures, fabricated local authority, recursive full-game blob or full-tree coverage claim is introduced. Domain/generated persistence types remain separated.

Normal scaffold integration, off-UI database work, explicit non-destructive failure presentation and Android cloud/adb/device-transfer exclusion of private state belong to I01d2. Token/Keystore/auth/logout/callback-fence behavior remains I02/I03; downloader staging I05; actual gameplay replica/prediction and complete-tree transfer I14/I26; signed upgrade/mixed-version support I35.

The unchanged I01d parent closes only after both children and combined qualification. Compiling instrumentation satisfies the selected assembly obligation, not the separately retained I01f device-execution obligation. No account/gameplay journey, full product scenario or external gate can pass from this planning record.

sourceIds.feedback: No F-specific UI behavior is implemented or redesigned by this split. All F01-F88 obligations and the eventual complete both-orientation mock review stay assigned to existing feature/B8 tasks. No UI document edit/publication occurs.
sourceIds.accounting: T-662's existing I01 ownership covers only the storage foundation interfaces here; full runtime/Compose/durable inbox/outbox and signed process-replacement assertions remain assigned to I01/I13/I35. T-632's full signed Android upgrade scenario stays I35. P-059/P-060/P-063/P-065 and T-647/T-649/T-657 constrain authority, API support, accepted state, volatile restart and private backup handling without pulling their later owning capabilities forward. No ledger assertion or scenario is marked executed.

The implementing children must qualify actual compatible SQLDelight/plugin/host/Android driver versions and retained-schema fixtures with real builds; this plan deliberately does not guess patch versions, schema payload encodings or introduce another platform module.
No subagent, session, loop, paid resource, device or deployment was started. The planning helper imports only pure driver functions and never constructs/launches a controller.

All release gates remain unverified and unchanged. Actual Android storage-driver execution is I01f, complete supported-device/signed-upgrade qualification I35 and reference physical-phone performance I33; no unavailable measurement is waived.
